Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.About LihirOur Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.Your ImpactAs a Technician, Processing, you’ll play a key role in operating critical sections of the process plant, including grinding circuits, flotation, and thickener operations. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry.We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond. jobs.description: LAE CCTV TECHNICIANShare this job:Location:Morobe,Papua New GuineaIndustry:IT, TechnicianSalary:TBC(PGK)Job ID:#24983Date Posted:27th October 2025Source:www.pngworkforce.comLocation: Lae, MorobeCCTV technician - Job DescriptionCCTV technician is responsible for installing and maintaining closed-circuit television systems. They commonly work with video cameras, monitors, recording devices, networking equipment, and other related hardware to ensure that these systems are functioning properly at all times.CCTV technician may also be called upon to troubleshoot problems with the system or its components. This might involve anything from replacing broken parts to diagnosing software issues or other technical difficulties.CCTV Technician Skills RequiredTechnical skills:Technical skills are the abilities and knowledge that allow you to perform tasks and complete projects. Technical skills are essential for a CCTV technician as they allow you to install, repair and maintain security systems. Technical skills can include knowledge of electrical systems, computer software and security protocols.Communication skills:Communication skills are necessary for a CCTV technician to have, as they must be able to clearly relay information to other technicians, and managers. They must also be able to listen to and understand requests from managers.Attention to detail:Attention to detail is the ability to notice small changes in a situation. It’s important for CCTV technicians to notice small changes in a room or area they’ve already inspected. This allows them to identify any new security threats and ensures they’ve thoroughly checked the area.Problem-solving skills:Problem-solving skills are essential for CCTV technicians because they often encounter challenges while installing and maintaining security systems. For example, if a camera isn’t working properly, a technician might need to find the source of the problem and fix it. Similarly, if a security system malfunctions, a technician might need to troubleshoot the system and find a solution.Ability to work independently:Working independently means that you can complete tasks without the help of others. As a CCTV technician, you may be required to install and repair security systems on your own. This means that you need to have the knowledge and skills necessary to complete the task.As a CCTV technician at Express Freight Management, you will be responsible for the installation, configuration, and maintenance of our CCTV systems. You will work with our team to ensure that our systems are up-to-date and functioning properly. You may be required to do training or be required to attend training that concerns CCTV systems. You are required to have experience with CCTV systems and networking, as well as a strong understanding of security protocols. You will be required to be detail-oriented and able to work independently.Duties & ResponsibilitiesCCTV RolesInstall, maintain, and troubleshoot CCTV systems according to company standards and department specifications.Perform site surveys to assess department needs and recommend solutions.Generate system diagrams and documentation for both internal use.Provide technical support and advice to departments as needed.Respond to service calls in a timely and professional manner.Keep up to date with the latest industry developments and technologies.Maintain and document accurate records of all installed systems.Always adhere to health and safety guidelines.Comply with all company policies and procedures.Installing, maintaining, repairing, and replacing security cameras, computer networks, and other equipment used in video surveillance systems and Information Systems (IT).Monitoring the operation of security equipment for malfunctions or other problemsInstalling and maintaining security equipment such as alarms, access control, or time attendance systemsStructural network cabling and installationRequired Skills and QualificationsHigh school diploma or equivalent2+ years experience in installation, maintenance, and repair of CCTV systemsWorking knowledge of CCTV equipment, including cameras, DVRs, and monitorsAbility to read and interpret technical manuals and drawingsBasic computer skills, with aptitude to learn new software and systemsPreferred Skills and Qualifications4+ years experience in installation, maintenance, and repair of CCTV systemsStrong working knowledge of CCTV equipment, including cameras, DVRs, and monitorsProficient in configuring CCTV systemsExperience developing and implementing CCTV systemsTo ApplyTo apply for this job simply click on the blue "Apply" button below. Project Planning and DesignDevelop detailed project plans, including scope, timelines, and resource allocation.Collaborate with engineers and project managers to design civil works (roads, bridges, drainage systems, utilities).Conduct feasibility studies and site assessments to determine project viability.Prepare accurate engineering drawings and specifications in accordance with regulatory standards.2. Site ManagementOversee construction activities, ensuring compliance with project specifications and quality standards.Coordinate with subcontractors and suppliers to facilitate smooth execution of project phases.Conduct regular site inspections to monitor progress, address issues, and ensure project integrity.Ensure proper implementation of survey data during construction phases.4. Quality Assurance and ControlEnsure compliance with engineering standards, safety regulations, and quality control procedures.Conduct material testing and maintain accurate project documentation.Prepare progress reports and recommend corrective actions when necessary.Document changes in project scope and manage approvals.5. Team Collaboration and LeadershipWork closely with multidisciplinary teams to achieve project goals.Provide guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technical staff.Ensure clear and effective communication among all team members and stakeholders.Review and approve construction methods and materials for compliance.6. Regulatory ComplianceEnsure all projects comply with local, state, and federal regulations.Obtain required permits and approvals from authorities.Conduct environmental assessments as needed.8. Problem-Solving and Decision-MakingIdentify and resolve project challenges while maintaining compliance with safety and regulatory standards.Make informed decisions regarding project modifications or design changes.Implement risk management strategies and address safety concerns on-site.9. Documentation and ReportingMaintain comprehensive project documentation, including contracts, change orders, and reports.Prepare and present progress reports to stakeholders.Document best practices and lessons learned for continuous improvement.10. Equipment Maintenance and CalibrationEnsure surveying equipment is maintained and calibrated for accurate data collection.Coordinate equipment repairs and replacements as necessary.Stay informed of technological advancements to enhance equipment performance.Job RequirementsBachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related field.Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.Minimum of 5 years of experience in civil engineering and/or surveying.Proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Civil CAD, and other engineering software.Strong project management and organizational skills.Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.Familiarity with construction materials, methods, and surveying equipment.OthersWorking ConditionsThis position involves extensive fieldwork and site visits, including travel to various project locations.Some physical activities, such as walking long distances, climbing, or carrying equipment, may be required.Split between office and fieldwork.
